description_en: Modifies the log delivery status of a protected object in Web Application Firewall (WAF)
description_zh: 修改防护对象日志外发投递状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-resource-log-delivery-status --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-uqm3500000 --delivery-name export-kafka --resource test.waf.com-waf --status true --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyResourceLogDeliveryStatus

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.
parameters.description_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。

parameters.description_en:
The name of the log delivery configuration.

> This parameter is required when you enable log delivery by setting **Status** to **true**.

外发投递配置名称。

parameters.description_en:
Indicates whether to enable log delivery for the protected object. Valid values:

- **true**: enables log delivery.

- **false**: disables log delivery.
parameters.description_zh:
防护对象日志外发投递状态。取值：

- **true**：表示开启。

- **false**：表示关闭。
